Project Title: Connected Identity Intelligence Platform for Digital Investigation
Grant Supplier: Government of Sindh — Sindh Higher Education Commission (Sindh HEC)
Project Details: This project addresses three under-studied identity resolution problems in Pakistan by building three independent AI services: multilingual entity resolution with Urdu/English NER and CNIC-aware matching, LLM-driven generation of Urdu and English name variants (such as Mubashir, Mubashar and Mubasher) with confidence scores, and face matching with demographic-fairness auditing on a regionally representative test set. Each service is evaluated on curated benchmarks and backed by a peer-reviewed publication. Deliverables include trained models, annotated benchmark datasets released for reuse, model cards, and a published API specification so any compliant application can integrate the services.

Project Title: Integrated Information Discovery System for Digital Investigation
Grant Supplier: Government of Sindh — Sindh Higher Education Commission (Sindh HEC)
Project Details: This project builds an on-premises investigation workspace for regulatory, compliance, audit, and journalistic work. Investigators usually start with little information about a subject and spend hours gathering and cross-checking public data from disconnected sites and tools. The platform cuts that work to minutes while keeping every result traceable to its source and a human in control.
